title: Run
description: Harness metadata for one execution phase. Not embedded in Trace. Join on trace_id (and Trace.run_id). Grouping several phases into one experiment is out of scope for this freeze. fix_* is written by the harness when a fix is applied, not by Grok.

run_id.description: Identity of this harness record. Trace.run_id points here.

injection_plan_id.description: Set for injected chaos runs. Omitted for baseline and for after_fix replays that are not themselves injections.

fix_id.description: Identifier of the fix the harness applied. Typically matches Diagnosis.proposed_fixes[].fix_id.

fix_summary.description: Harness record of what was applied.
